data_disclaimer: SYNTHETIC precedents authored by an LLM for the held-out evaluation. Disjoint from eval/precedent_cases.json.

precedents.summary: A flurry of micro-donations to charity checkouts, each under four dollars, with most returned as declines from a freshly opened profile.
precedents.resolution_notes: Charity checkouts are used to probe stolen card numbers because receipts look innocuous. Card list blocked.

precedents.summary: Automated browser hammering a prepaid top-up page with sequential small loads from a datacentre address.
precedents.resolution_notes: Headless client, rotating card numbers. Merchant notified.

precedents.summary: Dozens of one-dollar app-store style charges across three storefronts within an hour; account opened the previous evening.
precedents.resolution_notes: Enumeration of a leaked BIN block.

precedents.summary: Credential reset followed minutes later by a very large order for resellable electronics shipped to a newly saved address abroad.
precedents.resolution_notes: Customer confirmed they did not reset. Account recovered, address blacklisted.

precedents.summary: Long-standing customer; sudden jewellery spend from unfamiliar handset in another continent, impossible given a card-present swipe earlier the same day.
precedents.resolution_notes: Cloned device profile used from overseas. Funds returned.

precedents.summary: Support-chat social engineering preceded a device swap and a cash-equivalent purchase at four times the normal ticket, from a domestic residential address.
precedents.resolution_notes: Attacker had the customer's partial identifiers from a data dump; passed callback verification as the genuine holder.

precedents.summary: Gift voucher purchases through a newly enrolled phone after a password change; location plausible, amounts moderate.
precedents.resolution_notes: Quiet takeover pattern; losses small per event but recurring across customers.

precedents.summary: Applicant with mismatched social number profile used the card lightly for two months, then cashed out several thousand through an exchange.
precedents.resolution_notes: Fabricated identity; linked applications used same phone prefix.

precedents.summary: Cluster of fresh sign-ups with near-identical email stems and phone numbers; each maxed credit within weeks of opening.
precedents.resolution_notes: Single operator farming identities. Cluster closed.

precedents.summary: Thin-file borrower with pending verification suddenly purchased high-value jewellery; sibling accounts share payment instruments.
precedents.resolution_notes: Bust-out ring; recovery partial.

precedents.summary: Incoming transfers forwarded to remittance services within the hour from an account sharing a handset with six other profiles.
precedents.resolution_notes: Mule network recruited via social media job adverts.

precedents.summary: Student account with clean verification receives and immediately forwards funds; its payment instrument also appears on a dozen unrelated accounts.
precedents.resolution_notes: Genuine student unwittingly recruited; account restricted, customer educated.

precedents.summary: Disposable email domains and a single residential proxy pool across many accounts that redeemed welcome credit and bought resellable digital items.
precedents.resolution_notes: Bonus farming ring; credits clawed back.

precedents.summary: Tenured customer abroad with plane and hotel charges on the card in the days before, buying meals and taxis in the destination city.
precedents.resolution_notes: Customer confirmed holiday via app message. No action.

precedents.summary: Alert on a new phone: device fingerprint changed twice after an OS update; same city, same billing, usual merchants.
precedents.resolution_notes: Handset upgrade confirmed. Rule threshold for device churn loosened for tenured accounts.

precedents.summary: Customer using a corporate VPN gateway for years; the tripped proxy rule was the only oddity on an otherwise unremarkable profile.
precedents.resolution_notes: Habitual VPN use. Allow-listed.

precedents.summary: Large furniture purchase on an enhanced-verified account with a prior purchase of similar size from the same retailer last year.
precedents.resolution_notes: Customer had pre-notified the bank of a home renovation.

precedents.summary: Family tablet shared among spouse and children, each aged account verified; linked in the graph since 2023.
precedents.resolution_notes: Household link, no fraud. Added to family-device allow list.

precedents.summary: Shopping-mall afternoon: eight card-present swipes in nearby stores, no declines, customer's own phone present.
precedents.resolution_notes: Normal weekend shopping.

precedents.summary: Two-week-old account with coffee, bus fare and groceries swiped in person; verification still in progress.
precedents.resolution_notes: Newly onboarded customer behaving normally.

precedents.summary: Reseller with scripted order placement from a cloud server, but a three-year verified business history of steady wholesale-sized buys.
precedents.resolution_notes: Customer's order-management software. Documented and allow-listed.

precedents.summary: Customer's annual insurance premium and utility bills paid by card on the usual day each month, flagged by an amount rule.
precedents.resolution_notes: Recurring payments.

precedents.summary: Tenured holder abroad bought crypto for the first time from a new phone; no travel booking on file. Call-back went unanswered.
precedents.resolution_notes: Customer later reported the login as unauthorised.

precedents.summary: Tenured holder abroad bought crypto from a new phone; no booking on file; customer phoned back and confirmed an overseas business trip.
precedents.resolution_notes: Reached on second attempt; trip confirmed with employer letter.

precedents.summary: Three fresh accounts on one laptop, each unremarkable; reviewer asked branch staff to check ID documents.
precedents.resolution_notes: Flatmates; IDs checked in person.

precedents.summary: Three fresh accounts on one laptop, each unremarkable; later found opened within an hour of each other from one address.
precedents.resolution_notes: Mule starter set; second review found same-session onboarding.

precedents.summary: Elderly customer sends an unusually large amount to a first-time payee from their usual computer; relative later confirmed the transfer was genuine.
precedents.resolution_notes: Funeral expenses abroad.

precedents.summary: Elderly customer sends an unusually large amount to a first-time payee from their usual computer; call revealed coaching by an unknown caller.
precedents.resolution_notes: Romance scam; transfer stopped before settlement.

precedents.summary: Month-old account buys several hundred dollars of vouchers; little history to compare against.
precedents.resolution_notes: Birthday gifts, confirmed by customer.

precedents.summary: Month-old account buys several hundred dollars of vouchers; little history to compare against.
precedents.resolution_notes: Account later linked to a mule cluster.

precedents.summary: Pattern of tiny streaming-trial sign-ups using a different card number each minute from one browser profile.
precedents.resolution_notes: Trial endpoints probed for live PANs.

precedents.summary: SIM-swap suspected: one-time passcodes delivered to a new number followed by a large crypto purchase.
precedents.resolution_notes: Carrier confirmed port-out fraud.

precedents.summary: Remote-access trojan evidence: purchase placed from the customer's own device while a screen-sharing app was active.
precedents.resolution_notes: Customer duped by fake technical support; refunded under policy.

precedents.summary: Marketplace seller account receives many small buyer payments then sweeps to a single payee abroad daily.
precedents.resolution_notes: Fake storefront collecting payments.

precedents.summary: Gig worker receives many small inbound payments and withdraws weekly to their own bank account.
precedents.resolution_notes: Payout pattern of a delivery courier.

precedents.summary: Teenager with parent-managed account makes a first large gaming purchase after birthday money was deposited.
precedents.resolution_notes: Gift from grandparents, confirmed.

precedents.summary: Foreign billing address but long relationship; customer is an expatriate with home-country shopping each month.
precedents.resolution_notes: Expat customer; profile updated.

precedents.summary: Night-shift nurse purchases groceries and fuel at 3 a.m. weekly.
precedents.resolution_notes: Shift schedule explained.

precedents.summary: Authorised-user piggybacking: dozens of cards added as authorised users on one aged account to inherit its credit history.
precedents.resolution_notes: Credit-renting scheme.

precedents.summary: Cloud-hosted ordering at a small online shop with unverified owner details; no declines, no complaints.
precedents.resolution_notes: Merchant onboarding paperwork produced; fine.
